summary.name: WhimsyDesk
summary.one_liner: A free, open source set of Mac desktop organizer apps where files are stored in playful objects like a fridge, drawer, post box or vending machine.
use_cases: Tidy files off the Mac desktop into playful containers
Drag and drop files into a desktop object and restore them later
Create a custom desktop object from a template
Keep file organization apps offline with no tracking
summary.what_it_does:
WhimsyDesk provides free, open source desktop objects for macOS, such as a fridge, drawer, mailbox and vending machine, that hold files you drag onto them. Files are moved into one plain folder viewable in Finder, and a Put Back action returns each file to its original location, even after a restart. The apps are described as quiet at rest, with no timers or animation when idle, and as never going online, with no analytics or accounts. The page also explains how to make your own object from a template using Phoenix Code, the terminal, or an AI assistant, and how to submit it via a GitHub pull request.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Desktop objects with movable doors and drawers that hold and restore files
Put Back returns every file to its original location, even after restart
No network access, tracking, ads or accounts, per the page
Template-based maker workflow for building new objects without Swift
caveats: Windows support is described as beta
Requires macOS 14 or later for the Mac apps
Making a new object is described as needing a GitHub fork and tools like Phoenix Code or an AI assistant
